label: lem:interval_integrable_restriction
title: Interval integrability restriction to sub-intervals
statement: If $f$ is interval integrable on $[a,b]$ and $\min(a,b) < x < \max(a,b)$, then $f$ is interval integrable on $[a,x]$, since $\texttt{uIcc}\; a\; x \subseteq \texttt{uIcc}\; a\; b$. This is \texttt{IntervalIntegrable.mono\_set}.
